protocol.entry: first subsequent bar open; suspension/missing-bar distinction unverified
protocol.exit: entry bar + horizon - 1: QFQ close / QFQ open - 1
protocol.top_k: up to 5 distinct stocks; select before inspecting outcomes
protocol.same_names_baseline: retrospective diagnostic, not a PIT strategy
protocol.wf: past fully matured 5D IC, minimum 20 days, signed mean weights, current percentile ranks
protocol.costs: 0/20/40 bp round-trip sensitivity; no calibrated execution/slippage model
protocol.block_bootstrap: 3000 moving-block draws; block=holding horizon; consecutive observed days

runtime_facts.registry: loaded content matches trained challenger record; no champion
runtime_facts.price_limits_in_export: RAW up_limit/down_limit all missing; suspension field always false

interpretation.status: ANALYSIS_COMPLETED; audit code/tests completed; no model repair, training, freeze, preflight or deployment
interpretation.incorrect_aggregate: 62.84%/+2.958% and 68.30%/+6.292% are replayed-only, not all 19,500 samples. Matured pooled results are 58.30%/+2.014% and 63.49%/+4.645%.
interpretation.dedup_bias: Deduplicate separately by provenance. Mixing modes first removes 790 observed candidates; independent observed cohort has 6997 candidate rows.
interpretation.baseline_weighting: Match market and same-name controls by entry date. On corrected cohort, 5D observed 48.83% vs market 47.65%, 10D 51.48% vs market 51.70%. Market paired moving-block confidence intervals contain zero; same-name diagnostic remains stronger.
interpretation.causality: Serving artifact trained on 15,977 observed gold samples with soup v1 label. The v3 bronze models are separate challengers. Bronze cannot currently be identified as the cause of serving-model weakness.
interpretation.timezone: NAS process clock is Asia/Shanghai. Naive datetime.now() is serialized with replace(tzinfo=UTC); snapshots decision time is roughly 8 hours later than UTC created_at. For this audit only, recorded wall-clock date is explicitly retained; history is not overwritten.
interpretation.model_probabilities: Serving model predicts TP8-before-SL5 over 10D, not P(5D net return >0). ScoreEngine total_score/100 is not an upward probability. A rank v3 model also would not predict that event.
interpretation.strategies: Restored observed trend 5D 52.67%/+1.020%, monster 47.74%/-0.371%. Same-entry-date market control for trend 52.67%; trend edge is not established.
interpretation.walk_forward: Our fixed independent protocol gives 33 fully mature 5D evaluation days / 162 selections: meta 38.27%/-0.492%, completion 45.06%/+0.436%, IC mix 49.38%/+0.880%. IC mix excess CI [-0.985%,+2.635%] contains zero. 10D IC mix 29.55%/-1.911%. Earlier 28-day probe exact weights/tie handling were unavailable; its precise figures were not independently reproduced.
interpretation.limitations: Logged candidates, not final actionable recommendations. QFQ research ratios, not trades. No fill/limit-down/T+1 execution replay, no cash dividends reconciliation. Costs 20/40bp are sensitivity scenarios only. Same-name universe is retrospective. Repeated weekend/stale scans and overlapping holdings reduce independence. Three months are insufficient to certify stability; count of unique scores alone does not prove model collapse.
priorities: Audit/fix timestamp and identity contracts for new records; preserve history with explicit migration provenance.
Define separate absolute event-probability label for chosen horizon/costs and expected return/downside heads; do not reinterpret soup or rank scores as upward probability.
Separate trend/monster and fresh/stale/non-actionable stages; retain final scores, actions, gate status, score source, feature compute version and loaded model hash in immutable decision evidence.
Validate training/live feature values and as-of sources. Serving 197-column model has none of the relative-index features; existing index-feed fixes are not automatically learned by that artifact.

Use longer PIT-safe training panels; replay must be historically blind and matched to live population. Observed-only live-performance reports plus source-separated training gates; no arbitrary universal bronze percentage threshold.
Pre-register purged walk-forward, matched baselines, actual execution/cost/no-fill assumptions, Top-K and coverage/downside gates; require new future shadow evidence before model replacement.
